outline:
使學生瞭解塑性變形對材料機械性質物理性質化學性質之影響，實習內容如下： 1. 鋼鐵、非鐵材料在各種加工度下之機械性質變化實驗。 2.不鋼料（18-8不鋼）在各種加工度下之耐蝕性比較實驗。 3. 線材之抽拉實驗，各種潤滑劑對抽拉力之影響。 4. 加工硬化對退火處理之組織變化，結晶粒大小之影響。 5. 塑性試驗模（plastic thinmold）操作及在壓軋加工下之變形模擬實驗。 6. 鍛造加工實驗。7. 板材之引伸加工實驗。
It makes students understand how plastic deformation influence mechanical , physical and chemical properties, the course content includes the following items: 1.The mechanical property change under all kinds of work degree for steel, iron and non-ferrous metal. 2.The comparative anti-corrosion test under all kinds of work degree for stainless steel(18-8 stainless steel) 3.The tension test of metal material, and how lubricator influences drawing force. 4.How work hardening influence tissue change at the tempering treatment, and how it influences crystal grain size. 5.The deformation simulation test under plastic thinmold operation and rolling & pressing processing. 6.Forging processing text. 7.The tensile processing test of plates.
